brief: Two pairs of bases. Bolt the two bases of each pair together, with no connector inside a pair. Put the pairs side by side and fit a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other.

requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases (four bases total)
requirements.evidence: Four full bases in a row on level 0: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full, piece:3,0,0;full. check_build confirms two groups: [0,0 1,0] and [2,0 3,0].

requirements.requirement: The two bases of each pair bolted together
requirements.evidence: jointBolt:0#0,0#0 bolts the wall 0,0|1,0 (pair A) and jointBolt:0#3,0#3 bolts the wall 2,0|3,0 (pair B); each group stays one body on its bare bolted wall.
get_build topology lists walls 0,0|1,0 and 2,0|3,0 as bare with no connector; only the between-pair wall carries a connector.

requirements.requirement: Pairs side by side with a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other
requirements.evidence: The pairs touch on exactly one wall, 1,0|2,0, which carries connector:0#1,0|2,0 (side-connector-double); topology confirms this wall is the only connector wall and separates the two groups.

finish.summary: Built four full bases in a row (0,0 to 3,0, level 0). Pair A (0,0 + 1,0) and Pair B (2,0 + 3,0) are each bolted together with a joint bolt on their shared wall and carry no connector inside the pair. The pairs sit side by side touching on the single wall 1,0|2,0, which carries a double side connector joining the two groups — that is every wall where one pair touches the other. Open faces were capped with solid end caps; lockJoints was deliberately not run, as it could have bolted further walls and blurred the pair structure. check_build passes with no issues and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
